description: Generate AI videos, images, voiceovers and music with one varg API key. Text- and image-to-video on Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1 and Wan 3; images and edits on Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.6 and Flux 3; lip sync and talking avatars; ElevenLabs v4 voices; Lyria and Mureka music; captions and multi-scene renders to MP4. Use when someone asks to make or render a video, animate a photo, generate an image, create a UGC ad, product video, slideshow or talking head, add voiceover (text to speech), music, lip sync or captions, or mentions varg. Cloud mode needs only curl; local mode runs on bun + ffmpeg.
